descriptions.text: Enchanted Toe Ring of the Well-Balanced. This special, dainty, perfectly delightful toe ring (which, by the way, must be equipped on your left pinky toe. Don't test me on this) represents balance. […] When properly equipped, (again, left pinky) this toe ring imbues the following effects: Heart Balance, Level 5. Allows you to store one auto-trigger potion item if health reaches a certain criteria. Mind Balance, Level 5. Allows protection from Enslavement and Conscription. Physical Balance, Level 5. At level five, this skill imbues both the Extra Steady Balance skill and the Walk on Air Skill (already obtained.)

recap.text: Carl slips on the silver toe ring from the Legendary Spicy Box, and Mind Balance blocks hundreds of casts by Shi Maria, the tattoo on his chest, that would likely have killed Donut. A screen shows Imani prying the ring off his toe as he lies on the cot, and the entity controlling him accepts a warlord's teleport invitation. At level sixteen, Mind Balance wakes him from psionic debuffs and negates Eris's Bear Witness.

On the road into the cannibals' village, a huge man in an ape-skull mask blocks the way with a staff, then pulls the mask off to show a balding human with red hair in a bone-pinned bun. He starts to chant. Carl's Mind Balance skill negates the Soul Suck, and Donut is immune anyway, thanks to her constitution and charisma. Carl reads the description and can hardly believe it.

beats.headline: Left pinky. Don't test me
beats.text: The Legendary Spicy Box is shaped like a giant strawberry that sizzles as it opens, and inside is a simple, silver, unadorned toe ring. The description insists, twice, on the left pinky toe. Walk on Air, already obtained: that makes no sense to Carl. He knows what the skill does, and he did not have it. It is what Li Jun used when he fought, and the taste of Li Jun's eye floods his mouth. He slips the ring on, sets a gold-standard healing potion to trigger at two per cent health, and gets an ominous notice. Mind Balance is currently triggered.
beats.gist: Carl slips on the silver toe ring from the strawberry box; Mind Balance triggers.

beats.headline: Hundreds of attempts
beats.text: Carl turns his interface back on and reads the suppressed notifications. Gloom Wraith Phase failed to activate. Mind Balance prevented activation. Your attempt to disable Mind Balance was prevented by Mind Balance. It is level nine, up from five a few hours ago, over pages of attempts to cast that he never made. Shi Maria, the tattoo on his chest, is trying to use him; had the phase gone off, it would likely have set off the ogre's non-magical bombs, and Donut would have died. Even so the spider breaks in for a moment. Watch out, Carl.
beats.gist: Carl's toe ring blocks Shi Maria's hundreds of attempts to cast Gloom Wraith Phase.

beats.headline: Pried off
beats.text: Before three adjutants, the night of the treatment plays on a screen. A warlord's teleport invitation reached Carl's interface while he was still conscious. Then Rosetta, Bucket Boy and Mordecai stand over him on the cot while Imani pries off his toe ring, as the cure required once he was out. The moment the ring comes off, the request is accepted, by the entity controlling him.
beats.gist: Imani pries off Carl's toe ring, and the entity controlling him accepts the warlord's teleport.

beats.headline: Level sixteen
beats.text: Slapped awake, Carl is hammered with psionic debuffs: ten more Endless Threads of Distraction, Self Harm, Intrusive Thoughts. His Mind Balance is overwhelmed, and he thinks of surrendering. A voice tells him to look at his feet, bare and buried in an All Tree root. Mind Balance is level sixteen now, trained past fifteen on battlefield conditions, and it wakes him. When Eris casts Bear Witness over almost the whole floor, everyone around him freezes. His Mind Balance negates it.
beats.gist: Carl's Mind Balance, now level sixteen, wakes him from psionic debuffs and negates Eris's Bear Witness freezing everyone.

beats.headline: Soul Suck
beats.text: On the road into the cannibals' village, a huge man with a staff stands in the way and pulls off his ape-skull mask: a human, balding, red hair in a bone-pinned bun. He starts to chant. Soul Suck has been negated by your Mind Balance skill. Donut is immune anyway, thanks to her constitution and charisma. Carl reads the description and can hardly believe it.
beats.gist: Soul Suck is negated by Carl's Mind Balance skill, and Donut is immune anyway.

relations.note: its Mind Balance blocks her attempts to cast through Carl
